_about: Per-week fetal size and proportions for the stage shape keys and the timeline tool. Biometry (BPD, HC, AC, FL in mm) is Hadlock 1984 (16-40 w, via babymed.com); 12-15 w are extrapolated along the same curves and marked approx. Length/weight are the commonly cited growth-chart averages (crown-rump to 13 w, crown-heel after; perinatology.com, WHO-based charts). Values are population means for illustration, not diagnostic.

appearance.12: Head about half the body; limbs short and thin; skin thin and translucent; eyelids fused.
appearance.16: Neck lengthens, head less dominant; limbs lengthen; skin translucent with visible vessels.
appearance.20: Lanugo covers the body; vernix begins; skin red and wrinkled, little fat.
appearance.24: Skin reddish, wrinkled and semi-translucent; body lean; lungs begin surfactant.
appearance.28: Eyelids open (26-28 w); fat begins to fill in, skin smoothing.
appearance.32: Body rounding with subcutaneous fat; skin less translucent.
appearance.36: Skin pink and smooth, body rounded; lanugo mostly shed.
appearance.40: Full-term: plump, rounded limbs; head roughly a quarter of body length.
